t: Threatening Letters From Wang Ching Wei Organizations To Trading People In The Settlement

pages.en:

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Section 1, Special Branch
REPORT

File No.
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTRY
No. S. B. D. 7939
Date: April 4, 1940.

Subject (in full) Threatening letters from Wang Ching Wei organizations to
trading people in the Settlement.

Made by... and .................................................... Forwarded by... D. I. Crawford

No reports have been made to the Police since
October, 1939 wherein Wang Ching Wei organizations have
dispatched letters of a threatening nature to business
people residing or carrying on business in the
International Settlement. In this case of October
1939, Li Tsu Wei, manager of the China Chemical
Industrial Company, 257 Honan Road, was instructed
not to insert advertisements in the Chinese American
Daily News or take the consequences.

A check has been made through F.A. to D.C. (Crime)
and D. D.O.s of the different divisions, but no further
cases have been unearthed.

C. Crawford
D. I.

D. C. (Special Branch)

DAIL 11, 4 40

报告

档案号
上海公共租界工部局警务处
特务科登记处
编号 S. B. D. 7939
日期：1940年4月4日。

主题（全称）汪精卫组织向租界内商界人士发送恐吓信。

制作人……及 …………………………………… 转呈人…… D. I. Crawford

自1939年10月以来，警方未收到任何关于汪精卫组织向居住或在公共租界内经商的商人发送恐吓信的报案。在1939年10月的这起案件中，河南路257号中国化学工业公司经理李祖卫（Li Tsu Wei）被指示不得在《中美日报》上刊登广告，否则后果自负。

已通过对各分区犯罪调查股（F.A.至D.C. (Crime)）及各分区副督察长（D. D.O.s）进行核查，但未发现其他案件。

C. Crawford
督察长

特务科副督察长

DAIL 11, 4 40

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE S. B. REGISTRY No. S.B.D. 44641 Date April 15, 1940.）
S. 1, Special Branch
REPORT

Subject Enquiry concerning Josef TRICKER.

Made by D. S. Hocking Forwarded by D. I. Crawford

The name Josef TRICKER does not appear
on the passenger manifest of the m.s. "Conte
Biancamano" which arrived in Shanghai in
September, 1939. A man of the same name landed
in Shanghai from Nagasaki on October 14, 1939,
per the s.s. "Nagasaki Maru" and departed for
Dairen on October 21, per the s.s. "Tsingtao
Maru". He stated himself to be of German
nationality, 43 years of age, an engineer by
profession and gave Siemens & Company as his
local forwarding address. Nothing further
regarding this man is contained in our files.

（签名：D.S. Hocking）
D. S.

D. C. (Special Branch).

（印：INDEXED BY / (C.B) REGIS / DATE 13/ / ）

主题 关于 Josef TRICKER 的查询。

制作人 D. S. Hocking 转呈人 D. I. Crawford

Josef TRICKER 这个名字并未出现在1939年9月抵达上海的“Conte Biancamano”号轮船的乘客名单上。一名同名男子于1939年10月14日乘坐“长崎丸”号轮船从长崎抵达上海，并于10月21日乘坐“青岛丸”号轮船前往大连。他自称德国国籍，43岁，职业为工程师，并提供西门子洋行作为其在沪的转交地址。我们的档案中没有关于此人的更多记录。
